DEVICE_DOC: Partitions found by lsblk. System partitions and disks mounted elsewhere are hidden. Press "Rescan disks" after plugging in a drive.
MOUNT_NAME_DOC: The disk is mounted to /mnt/<name>. Letters, digits, _ and - only. The names INTERNAL, USB, NAS, UPNP are reserved by Volumio.
LINK_MPD_DOC: Creates /var/lib/mpd/music/<name> so the disk shows up in the music library.
OPEN_PERMS: Everyone may write (FAT / NTFS / exFAT only)
OPEN_PERMS_DOC: Off: the volumio user owns the files, others can only read. On: any user and network share can write. Linux filesystems (ext4, xfs, btrfs) keep their own permissions.
STATUS_NO_HELPER: The system helper is not installed. Reinstall the plugin.
BAD_INPUT: Invalid folder name (letters, digits, _ and - only, up to 32 characters)
NO_HELPER: The system helper is missing, reinstall the plugin
TIMEOUT: No answer from the mount service within 40 seconds. Check: systemctl status disk-automount-apply
ERR_RESERVED_NAME: This folder name is reserved by Volumio
ERR_SYSTEM_DISK: Refused: this is a system disk or partition
ERR_ALREADY_MOUNTED: The disk is already mounted elsewhere
ERR_MP_BUSY: The mount folder is already in use
ERR_MP_NOT_EMPTY: The mount folder is not empty
ERR_LINK_CONFLICT: Cannot create the MPD library link, the name is taken
ERR_UNMOUNT_FAILED: Unmount failed (is the disk in use? stop playback and try again)
ERR_NOT_OURS: This mount was not made by the plugin, refusing to unmount it
